statement: Audit the retry and batch constants module: its batch ceiling, its default page size, and the error-code table it declares.

steps.prompt: Read `ptr_engine/tx01_constants.py` and list the module-level constants it defines.
Read `ptr_engine/tx01_constants.py` and report the value of `RETRY_LIMIT`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx01_constants.py` and report the value of `MAX_BATCH_SIZE`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and report the value of `SYM_02_OVERRIDE`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py` and report the value of `SYM_02`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx04_constants.py` and report the value of `F04_VAL_D`.
Read `ptr_engine/tx04_constants.py` and report the value of `F01_VAL_A`.
Read `ptr_engine/outcomes.py` and report the string value of `NOT_FOUND`.
Compare the batch ceiling you found in `ptr_engine/tx01_constants.py` at step 3 with the retry limit you found in the same file at step 2 and say which is larger.
Read `ptr_engine/tx01_constants.py` and report the value of `RETENTION_DAYS`.

final_question: Using the constant you identified at step 3 — do not restate it — report the value of the constant in the same file that sets the default page size.

checkpoints.question: What is the value of `SYM_02_OVERRIDE` in `ptr_engine/tx05_constants.py`?
What is the value of `F01_VAL_A` in `ptr_engine/tx04_constants.py`?
